description: This file implements the NetworkManager plugin for WPEFramework, including initialization, deinitialization, and connection management, with logging and notification registration.

classes.name: NetworkManager
classes.description: Implements the network management plugin, handling initialization, cleanup, and connection lifecycle events.

methods.name: NetworkManager::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers notifications, configures the network manager, and registers JSON-RPC methods.

methods.name: NetworkManager::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters notifications and methods, and releases interfaces.

methods.name: NetworkManager::Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information; currently no additional info.

methods.name: NetworkManager::Deactivated
methods.description: Handles unexpected remote connection termination and triggers deactivation.
